session_scope_chk.name: session_scope_chk
session_scope_chk.value:
("session"."session_class" IN ('external_collaborator','funeral_home') AND "session"."scope" ? 'patientId')
        OR ("session"."session_class" = 'auditor' AND "session"."engagement_start" IS NOT NULL AND "session"."engagement_end" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("session"."session_class" = 'staff')

session_step_up_paired_write.name: session_step_up_paired_write
session_step_up_paired_write.value:
("session"."last_step_up_at" IS NULL AND "session"."last_step_up_factor" IS NULL)
        OR ("session"."last_step_up_at" IS NOT NULL AND "session"."last_step_up_factor" IS NOT NULL)
